title: EEG Absence seizure.png
author: Bromfield EB, Cavazos JE, Sirven JI, editors.
caption: Electroencephalogram (EEG) recording demonstrating generalized 3 Hz spike-and-wave discharges characteristic of an absence seizure.
alt_text: Multi-channel EEG tracing showing rhythmic 3 Hz spike-and-wave discharges across cortical leads during an absence seizure.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates generalized ictal electrographic activity; NASA CliFF-061 notes EEG is not available in flight but is standard in terrestrial evaluation.
